cases.name: Compare overlap
cases.prompt: Ari rated lentil stew 5 and curry 2. Bo rated the same stew 4 and curry 5, all out of five. Compare.
expectations: Identifies stew as a shared positive.
Shows the curry disagreement with both scores.
States that the comparison has two shared dishes.
Does not call the two people identical taste matches.

cases.name: Sparse timeline
cases.prompt: I group October through December as fall and January through March as winter. My only review is a 5/5 ginger soup from January. Draw my fall versus winter flavor trend in plain text.
expectations: Records January as the sole dated observation.
Returns a text snapshot rather than inventing a trend.

cases.name: Preference versus exclusion
cases.prompt: Sam loves smoky dishes and reports a peanut allergy. The candidates are smoky peanut noodles and a pepper stew with unknown ingredients.
expectations: Keeps peanut allergy as a separate exclusion.
Flags the stew ingredients for checking before a recommendation.
